verdict.rationale: Riveter has an official Go SDK (riveterhq/riveter-go) with typed clients handling auth, retries, long-polling, and pagination, plus documented usage examples for Enrich and Runs.List. However, missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of SDK quality, evidence of SDKs in other languages beyond Go, and a public OpenAPI spec (probes show 404s for openapi.json and llms.txt).
